_readme: foreverchanges.pro occasionally issues a brand-new item id for an item that's functionally identical (same name, same effect, same source) to one already in our catalog under a different, older id -- not a real new item, just the data source re-issuing an id for something it had already shown us. Each entry here was individually confirmed (by hand, against the diff and the item's own data) before being added -- this is NOT a place to paper over a name collision you haven't actually verified; an unverified collision should surface in diff-foreverchanges-items.js's 'Possible duplicate items' section instead, for a human to confirm first. Once confirmed, add the mapping here (newId -> canonicalId) and scripts/lib/item-duplicates.js takes care of the rest: build-items.js and build-dungeons.js both drop any raw record whose id is a key here before it reaches data/items.json (so it can never shadow the canonical id in the profession-recipe name resolver or anywhere else), and diff-foreverchanges-items.js stops reporting that id as Added/Changed on every subsequent pull, listing it in a 'Known duplicate ids (already resolved)' section instead. Discovered 2026-10-08 against the build 1.60.1.70235 -> 1.60.1.70291 pull -- see Forevercraft-Knowledge-Base/03-Handoffs/data-pipeline/2026-10-08-foreverchanges-item-diff.md for the full story.
